Definition: from G164; to capture (like G163):--lead captive.
BiblicalUsage: This verb occurs once, in Ephesians 4:8, where Paul says Christ led captivity captive when He ascended. The picture is a victorious king marching home with his prisoners behind him — except here the prisoners are the powers that once held humanity captive, and the triumph ends in gifts, not chains, for His people.
TheologicalSignificance: One verb in one verse carries no theology of its own; the weight is in the scene, Christ the ascended King leading captives and handing out gifts.
